build_plan.exit_criteria: One190 by190 by28 Sun;24 lanes in four banks of six; all30 drops distinct solid occurrences; five positions times three layers on every lane; exact80 mm signature displacement and exposed bar, checked against DESIGN.md.

concept.interaction: Two players each own15 single-tail or fork-tail drops and use cup_1 and cup_2 to roll the shared die_1 and die_2. They move opposite ways around the Sun, hit single opposing drops onto its exposed central flare, enter barred drops before other moves, and drain all15 beside their six-point home bank to win. All35 components retain the ordinary1911 Backgammon functions. The legal signature6,2 roll shows its six-point first submove: one attacker replaces a lone fork-tail at the near rim and the victim lifts80 mm to the exposed flare. Historical opening choices, whole-throw use, doubles, touch laws,1/2/3 results and series starts remain binding as detailed in RULES-SOURCES.md.
concept.print_stance: All35 parts print flat-bottom down. Sun deck16 mm and flare crests28 mm; cups open side up. Solid dice receive thin ink face markings after printing. Loaded bar stacks may rise above28 mm; envelope describes individual product parts and Sun, not every possible table arrangement.
risks: Inner-station exact polygon clearance and planar stack contact require CAD checks.
Signature victim must overhang only the near radius90 rim between rounded rays and remain statically supported.
Exposed bar crests must remain outside seating rectangles and camera sightline.
Thin ink face markings and100 percent infill are manufacturing requirements; CAD alone does not establish fair dice.
concept.signature_decision: A fixed high three-quarter pair of exact states shows the single fork-tail overhanging the near solar rim by1 mm; attacker six points away; attacker then in its place and victim fully exposed on flare80 mm away. The radial plasma lanes and silhouette-coded tails express coronal circulation without copying a conventional board.
concept.summary: Backgammon — coronal-rain theme: rival streams of plasma drops crowd magnetic lanes, scatter lone drops, and rain back into the Sun.
concept.title: Rainward Sun

astronomy_sources.claim: Cooling plasma follows magnetic structures and can switch paths via reconnection; competitive plugs,hits and scoring remain an analogy, not a simulation.

closest_collisions.difference: Lunar phases on conventional luxury board; here original radial plasma lanes, exposed reheating and drainage.
Circular board alone already exists; no downloaded geometry incorporated. Rainward Sun uses original35-part coronal circulation system.

research.novelty_claim: An unusual original combination; bounded search cannot prove universal novelty.

period_clarification.claim: 1909 primary text explicitly rerolls tied starts and contests starts after gammon or backgammon, corroborating abbreviated1911 wording. Its divergent quadruple-scoring option is rejected.

popularity_sources.claim: 2021 federation article reports millions playing at home and digitally.
Independent Strong Museum collection record describes ongoing popularity and play in nearly every country.

rights_sources.claim: Penn identifies1911 as the last complete revision fully in US public domain; indexed full statement recovered after direct-fetch timeout.
Game methods differ from protectable prose and artwork; all new expression is original.

research.rules_equivalence: Every explicitly stated ordinary1911 rule preserved. Abbreviated opening and restart cases transparently interpreted with historical corroboration. No added powers,events,currencies,probability changes or modern cube.

rules_source.claim: Frozen ordinary rules, opening choices, touch laws, bearing,1/2/3 scoring and series starts; source omissions explicitly identified in RULES-SOURCES.md.
